market.rules_primary: If Pittsburgh wins the Pittsburgh vs Utah NHL game originally scheduled for Oct 19, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
market.rules_secondary: If the game is postponed but begins within 48 hours of its originally scheduled start time, the market will remain open and resolve based on the official final result.
